conditions.name: Cauda Equina Syndrome

ratingSchedule.note: No single cauda-equina diagnostic code is assigned here; neurologic residuals are evaluated under the affected peripheral nerve criteria as applicable.
When a spine disorder is part of the documented disability picture, applicable spine criteria may also govern evaluation; catalog identity does not select a rating code.

reviewNotes: No single condition-specific diagnostic code is assigned in the current schedule; evaluation depends on documented neurologic and other residuals rather than the catalog label alone.

conditions.name: Complex Regional Pain Syndrome

ratingSchedule.note: No dedicated CRPS diagnostic code is assigned here; neurologic residuals are evaluated under the affected peripheral nerve criteria as applicable.
Neuralgia, cranial or peripheral, is rated on the scale for the involved nerve when the documented manifestations meet that framework.

reviewNotes: No single condition-specific diagnostic code is assigned in the current schedule; the applicable evaluation depends on the documented nerve distribution and residual manifestations.

conditions.name: Cranial Nerve Palsy

ratingSchedule.note: No single generic cranial-nerve-palsy code exists. The schedule provides nerve-specific paralysis codes for the fifth, seventh, ninth, tenth, eleventh, and twelfth cranial nerves; lesions of the peripheral portions of the first, second, third, fourth, sixth, and eighth nerves are rated under the organs of special sense.

reviewNotes: No single condition-specific diagnostic code is assigned because the applicable rating depends on which cranial nerve is involved and the documented residuals.

conditions.name: Tibial Neuropathy

ratingSchedule.note: Schedule of ratings, neurological conditions and convulsive disorders; internal popliteal/tibial nerve diagnostic codes 8524, 8624, and 8724 and posterior tibial nerve codes 8525, 8625, and 8725 apply according to lesion location.

reviewNotes: The current schedule distinguishes the internal popliteal (tibial) nerve from the posterior tibial nerve; the applicable code set depends on the documented lesion location.
